result.summary: The home screen is mostly well rendered, but one defect stands out: the restaurant title "Tokumaru Ramen" in the Popular right now list is cut off mid-glyph, with the final "n" partially sliced. No other clear visual breakage was found.

issues.description: The restaurant name on the first "Popular right now" card is hard-clipped mid-character. It reads "Tokumaru Rameı", with the final "n" sliced vertically, even though there is plenty of empty horizontal space before the rating (4.8 (500+)). There is no ellipsis, which suggests the title container has a too-narrow fixed width with overflow hidden.
issues.suggestion: Remove the fixed or max width on the title and let it flex to fill the space up to the rating. If truncation is ever needed, use an ellipsis (text-overflow: ellipsis) rather than a hard clip.
